design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark-first portfolio/hub UI with a strong hero hierarchy, working light/dark themes, a clear mobile menu, visible keyboard focus states, and a clean labeled login modal. Main deductions come from the persistent floating Voice Agent widget overlapping card content (including clipped text on 'Reliability & Fact Check'), some low-contrast muted text in dark mode, and inconsistent theme-toggle iconography (gear icon in dark mode vs. moon icon in light mode).
strengths: Hero section establishes clear hierarchy: badge, large two-tone headline, supporting paragraph, stat bar, and two distinct CTAs (ui-home-desktop)
Light and dark themes both render correctly with intact layout and readable headline contrast (ui-theme-toggle)
Visible, high-contrast focus outline on the 'Explore' nav item demonstrates keyboard focus support (ui-keyboard-focus)
Mobile menu is cleanly structured with legible touch-sized nav items, persistent header actions, and a distinct 'Break it' button (ui-mobile-menu)
Login modal uses explicit field labels (Email/Password), placeholder guidance, clear Login/Register tabs, close control, and a full-width primary submit button (ui-login-modal)
Consistent four-card grid with icon, title, description, and action-link pattern across feature cards
issues: Floating 'Voice Agent' widget overlaps the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card, clipping its description text and partially covering the 'Check' action area (ui-home-desktop, ui-theme-toggle)
Theme toggle shows a gear/settings icon in dark mode but a moon icon in light mode — inconsistent iconography for the same control
Muted stat labels ('ARTICLES TODAY', 'RSS SOURCES', 'AUTO-UPDATED') and terminal code lines in the hero are small and low-contrast in dark mode
Close (X) button in the login modal is small and low-contrast, a poor tap/hit target
Vertical 'LIVE' tab on the left edge overlaps content edges on mobile and has no obvious dismissal or purpose shown
'Break it' button is visually the most prominent nav action (red, glowing) but its meaning is unexplained, creating ambiguity against standard nav items
